verdict.rationale: Vapi documents assistant hooks that automate actions when specific events occur during a call. That is event-triggered automation, but it is scoped to live calls rather than general background jobs. Importing Make/GHL workflows brings external workflows in as tools rather than providing native background automation. missing for 10: scheduled or recurring background automations, autonomous jobs that run outside a live call (e.g. outbound campaigns or triggers), documentation on monitoring background runs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Assistant hooks let you automate actions when specific events occur during a call.
Import existing Make scenarios and GHL workflows directly into Vapi
